limits: Records describe representative checked cases at the stated revisions, not a guarantee for your exact parameter values.
Software agreement, independent reference work, published examples and method-validation runs are separate evidence categories.
A green ordinary test suite is not evidence that skipped high-replication or untranscribed published checks passed.
No linked record means unknown coverage, not a failed test. Release-wide and statistician review remain separate.
